name: 48225 · Harper Woods, MI
findings: ZIP 48225 (Harper Woods) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48225 (Harper Woods) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48225 (Harper Woods) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
